name: chart_summary
expr: [(n, o.EmbeddedObject.HasMainTitle, o.EmbeddedObject.Title.String, o.EmbeddedObject.hasInternalDataProvider(), o.EmbeddedObject.Diagram is not None) for sh in [doc.Sheets.getByIndex(0)] for n in sh.Charts.ElementNames for o in [sh.Charts.getByName(n)]]

name: chart_ranges
expr: [(n, [(a.Sheet,a.StartColumn,a.StartRow,a.EndColumn,a.EndRow) for a in sh.Charts.getByName(n).Ranges]) for sh in [doc.Sheets.getByIndex(0)] for n in sh.Charts.ElementNames]
